faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for NAM Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date is 23 November 2026.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are there in NAM Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 6 vacancies: 3 Physiotherapist, 1 Nursing staff (Ayurveda), 2 Masseur (Male).

faq.question: Q3. How do I apply for NAM Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Apply online through the link in the Important Links table, on or before 23 November 2026.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The maximum age is 45 years.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary for this recruitment?
faq.answer: It depends on the post: 25000 for Physiotherapist, 15000 for Nursing staff (Ayurveda), 15000 for Masseur (Male).

faq.question: Q6. What qualification is needed for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Physiotherapist: BPT from a Govt. recognized Institute; Nursing staff (Ayurveda): one-year Certificate of Ayurveda Nurses' course from a Govt. recognized Institute; Masseur (Male): SSLC with one-year Certificate Course in Ayurvedic Masseur / Therapy from a recognized Ayurvedic Institute. The requirement for each post is in the eligibility table above.

faq.question: Q7. Are there other conditions for this recruitment besides qualification and age?
faq.answer: Yes. Masseur post is for male candidates (Masseur (Male)).

faq.question: Q8. Who cannot apply for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Applications received after 5:00 PM on 23 November 2026 will not be considered for the virtual interview.

faq.question: Q9. How will candidates be selected for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Virtual interview. Virtual interview; date, time and link communicated to eligible applicants through their registered e-mail.

faq.question: Q10. What are the terms of engagement for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Contractual posts for a period of one year. Likely to be extended based on satisfactory performance and subject to approval of the Ministry of AYUSH. Appointment strictly as per the scheme guidelines of the National AYUSH Mission.
